title: Sanctions on West Bank settlements aren’t enough
gist: After the UK, France and Canada sanctioned West Bank settlements, Yglesias argues such targeted measures are expressive but inadequate; because mainstream Israelis tolerate settler violence and Netanyahu's coalition depends on pro-violence parties, a US administration seeking real change would need to impose pain on mainstream Israelis in Tel Aviv and Haifa.
